heard: A secret military blunder caused France's deadliest train disaster. In 1917, over 1,000 French soldiers boarded a mountain train. Many believe a simple mechanical failure caused the tragic derailment. But a transport officer forced one engine to pull 19 coaches. Most officers actually abandoned the train for a faster express. The overloaded coaches lost their brakes, killing hundreds of soldiers. The army then hid this tragic failure for 90 years.
